notes: Eleven distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The paired leaves of each two-door upper cabinet are reported separately because they are distinct movable parts; their exact ordering is less certain where both motions occur within one 8-frame sampling interval.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a residential kitchen. The user opens and later closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper-cabinet doors, then manipulates lids on two countertop cookers and the drawer of an air fryer.
